mai (evals): Quick heads-up: orion-lite-q5 (int5 pipeline) shows a reproducible chapter-number flip in mixed zh+ar subtitles. BLEU -4.2 on the focused subtitle slice. Looks like token boundary + bidi marker issues around CJK chapter markers. :eyes:
jules (eng-ml): can you paste a tiny repro example?
mai (evals): short repro below (orig -> ref -> fp16 -> q5):
```
src: "第8章 - الصف 8: تجمع"
ref: "第8章 - الصف 8: تجمع"
orion-lite-fp16: "第8章 - الصف 8: تجمع"
orion-lite-q5: "第8 章 ‎- الصف 8: تجمع"
```
mai (evals): token dump (fp16 vs q5):
```
# fp16 tokens: ['第','8','章',' ','-',' ','الصف',' ','8',':',' ','تجمع']
# q5 tokens: ['第','8',' ','章',' ','‎','-',' ','الصف',' ','8',':',' ','تجمع']
```
tomo (quant): That inserted LRM (‎) + space inside the CJK cluster looks like a normalization/mini-tokenizer regression in the q5 export path. Q5 export flags: fold_ln=true, minify_tok=true, normalize_digits=true.
ade (serving): Runtime canary logs show `kvcache: index_mismatch seq=10 expected_off=52 got_off=48` for the failing request id. Also `decoder: seen_delim id=0` once.
rook (infra): export job trace: `EXPORT orion-lite -> q5 (fold_ln=true,minify_tok=true,normalize_digits=true) OK at 3133334440`. No CI errors. Canary routing enabled briefly; rolling back now at your request.
jules (eng-ml): mitigation: pause q5 rollout and route to fp16 in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. We should also add a tiny unit test for CJK+RTL punctuation pairs in export CI.
tomo (quant): immediate plan: bisect the export transforms: 1) minify_tok only, 2) normalize_digits only, 3) fold_ln only. I'll run `tools/bisect_export.sh orion-lite --cases minify,normalize,fold` and diff tokenizer outputs + token_id->kv_offset maps. ETA ~90m.
mai (evals): I'll run a focused subtitle subset (chapter headers + inline Arabic) and post BLEU/chrF deltas before/after any change.
ade (serving): pausing q5 routing now. Adding extra debug for token_id->kv_offset mapping in decoder logs for mixed-script requests.
deploy-bot: rollback executed: orion-lite-q5 routing -> fp16 (eu-west-1, ap-south-1) by rook at 3133334458
jules (eng-ml): Thanks everyone. Action items: tomo bisect export transforms, mai run focused eval slice, ade enable kv debug logs. We'll reconvene after bisect result. :calendar:
